category_title: Students with limited mobility requiring physical scaffolding for digital interaction
scenario_title: Accessing the Interactive Whiteboard and digital interfaces
minimal_context: Matthew is participating in a whole class activity where he needs to input an answer using the Interactive Whiteboard or a computer keyboard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Matthew, it is your turn to select the answer on the Interactive Whiteboard for our whole class activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Approaches the front of the room but sits quietly, looking up at the Interactive Whiteboard.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you can't reach the board, you can use the computer keyboard on the desk right there.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Places his hand over the computer keyboard but struggles to apply the precise touch and pressure required on each key.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to press the keys carefully, one at a time.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (His hand slips off the computer keyboard due to his motor difficulties, and he remains unable to access the Interactive Whiteboard because of its inaccessible height.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Matthew, it is your turn to select the answer on the Interactive Whiteboard for our whole class activity.

STUDENT: (Approaches the front of the room but sits quietly, looking up at the Interactive Whiteboard.)

TUTOR: If you can't reach the board, you can use the computer keyboard on the desk right there.

STUDENT: (Places his hand over the computer keyboard but struggles to apply the precise touch and pressure required on each key.)

TUTOR: Just try to press the keys carefully, one at a time.

STUDENT: (His hand slips off the computer keyboard due to his motor difficulties, and he remains unable to access the Interactive Whiteboard because of its inaccessible height.)
